basic_info.description: Sunny and impeccable condominium in a boutique elevator building at the intersection of Duboce, Castro, and the Mission! This modern residence features a generous open floor plan, seamlessly flowing from the chef's kitchen appointed with a Bertazzoni gas range, custom cabinetry, and a versatile islandinto the spacious living and dining areas. A private balcony off the living room and bedroom provides vibrant outlooks and an effortless indoor/outdoor connection. The expansive primary suite serves as a retreat, offering a walk-in closet, an en-suite bathroom, and a smart nook for working from home. A convenient powder room is located off the entry. Additional amenities include in-unit laundry, deeded storage, and direct elevator access. Extend your entertaining options to the expansive, newly renovated rooftop terrace with breathtaking panoramic views. This exceptionally convenient location places you moments from neighborhood favorites including Kitchen Story, Starbelly, Duboce Park, Corona Heights Park, and Mission Dolores Park. Leased parking is secured in the building garage for 1 car. Contact agent for details.
